The '''Strategic Advisor to Alderaan for the Republic Army''' was a specialized command position within the [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The position was created specifically in response to the violent and volatile [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] that had broken out on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and was designed to ensure that the Republic's support of the noble [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] was handled with strategic and political professionalism. Around [[3643 BBY]], near the end of the Cold War, the role was filled by [[Republic Army]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]], who had helped to defend Alderaan against a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Battle of Alderaan|invasion]] several decades prior.
